purpose: Fill only true sourcing gaps after Stage7 recovery using official supplier sources and strict truth gates.
rules: Supplier category is a discovery hint, never sufficient placement evidence.
Primary product type must match the target rail.
Existing HUNT source items are excluded from new-source recovery.
One exact variant must pass stock and destination shipping truth where required.
Image technical quality and category-semantic visual fit are separate gates.
Near-duplicate products do not count as useful shelf diversity.
Projected Product Contribution is not Final Net Profit.
Media-use rights remain a Production blocker when not explicitly verified.
No supplier order, checkout activation, payment activation or Production mutation.
